excerpt_i18n.en: Model parameter scales continue to break records, inference costs keep decreasing, and the open-source ecosystem is thriving. As model capabilities gradually become an industry consensus, a new question emerges: When everyone can access powerful model capabilities, what is left as true competitiveness? The answer is shifting from the model's own capabilities to building scalable intelligent systems around the model, and from point-specific capability improvements to systems engineering and organizational-level deployment capabilities.
excerpt_i18n.es: La escala de los parámetros de los modelos sigue superando límites, los costes de inferencia continúan disminuyendo y el ecosistema de código abierto es cada vez más próspero. Cuando la capacidad de los modelos se convierte gradualmente en un consenso en la industria, surge una nueva pregunta: después de que todos puedan acceder a potentes capacidades de modelos, ¿qué queda como verdadera ventaja competitiva? La respuesta se está desplazando de la capacidad del modelo en sí misma a la construcción de sistemas inteligentes escalables en torno al modelo; de la mejora de capacidades puntuales a la capacidad de ingeniería de sistemas y de implementación a nivel organizativo.

items.title: How do you as a normal swe use AI?
items.raw_excerpt: So am looking for more normal people, experienced people using AI, but I feel like whenever I hit youtube or other platforms the AI culture is way deep in the trenches and don't feel like this is how the majority of people tackle work, especially at their jobs. What I see is mostly solo-devs going full battlestar gallactica on things. And I just want to see other people, normal people talk about and show how they use these new tools. I'm also more interested in the first principles of things and not necessarily the shiny new model or shiny new workflow or shiny new thing. More towards problem solving. So, if you have a bit of time to walk me through how you usually work in a day or point me to some good videos, resources on regular people doing it I'll be grateful!

excerpt_i18n.en:
Why would a CPU chip company build an operating system? On July 17, Cixi Technology launched its AGX Agentic Compute strategy at the first day of WAIC 2026, unveiling products such as the AGX Station. More noteworthy than a desktop device capable of running large models locally is that Cixi simultaneously released Agentic OS—an operating system designed for agent execution. The answer to the question lies in this: competition in agentic computing is shifting from who provides computing power to who can orchestrate that power, manage risks, and deliver it to end users. What Cixi Technology aims to solve is precisely this orchestration hub that connects chips, accelerators, models, and applications.

From Generative AI to Agents, the Computing System Is Redefined
Over the past two years of generative AI, the core has been content production. A user gives a prompt, and the model returns a text, an image, or a slide deck. This interaction remains human-centric: the human raises the request and is also responsible for evaluating results, correcting errors, and executing the next step.

But once agents start "working," the equation changes. The system that computing power serves is extending from human-centric interaction to agent-centric automated execution. And what agents need is no longer just a single higher-performance chip or a more powerful accelerator card.

excerpt_i18n.en:
A palm-sized Agent Computer capable of driving a large model with hundreds of billions of parameters, a 24/7 local “desktop AI assistant” that auto-generates PPT from a single sentence; a holographic interactive personal terminal that renders real-time graphics and drives a continuously conversing digital human… On July 18, at WAIC 2026 Zhangjiang Science Hall, Houmo Smart unveiled multiple M50 Inside innovative AI terminals, bringing large models from the cloud to local devices and making edge intelligence readily accessible.

As large-model inference shifts to the edge, the edge AI market has exploded. Various terminal devices now possess full-process capabilities including autonomous memory, intelligent retrieval, logical reasoning, and self-directed task execution. The industry widely regards 2026 as the first year of edge AI, with products such as AI PCs, intelligent service robots, and edge smart terminals accelerating deployment in commercial scenarios.

While large-model parameter scales continue to expand, terminal devices face rigid constraints on size, battery power, and heat dissipation. Challenges in compute power, power consumption, latency, and deployment have become core bottlenecks for large-scale edge deployment, making high-compute, low-power, easy-to-deploy edge AI chips an industry necessity.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 7月17日，2026世界人工智能大会暨人工智能全球治理高级别会议在上海开幕。本届大会以“智能伙伴，共创未来”为主题。作为全球商用服务机器人领军企业，普渡机器人于大会首日举办“从服务世界到智造未来——普渡AI技术灯塔沟通会”，系统阐释“一脑多形”Physical Agent技术 理念 ，并首次在线下展示类人形智能作业伙伴PUDU D7。 当具身智能从实验室走向产业化深水区，谁能在真实商业场景中率先跑通「技术-产品-商业化-数据」的闭环，谁就能定义Physical AI 时代的游戏规则。全球商用服务机器人市场收入与出货量双料第一的普渡机器人，正在以实际行动给出自己的答案。 普渡具身智能产品线总经理吴翔于沟通会现场 Physical AI时代， 机器人正在成为AI进入真实世界的关键载体 过去几年，大语言模型、多模态模型和AI Agent快速发展，让人工智能完成了从“生成内容”到“理解任务”的跨越。而随着感知、推理、规划和执行能力不断成熟，AI开始走出数字空间，进入真实物理世界 。沙利文《2025年全球具身智能与商用服务机器人独立市场研究报告》指出，随着大模型、多模态模型和AI Agent持续成熟，AI能力正从内容生成延伸至真实物理任务执行。机器人凭借感知、移动、交互和执行能力，将成为Physical AI时代最重要的终端载体之一。 与此同时， 《十五五规划建议》 也 明确提出，推动具身智能等成为新的经济增长点。沙利文报告判断，商用服务机器人覆盖配送、清洁、导览等场景，能够直接解决人力成本上升、服务效率不足等行业痛点，具备率先规模化落地的现实基础。 普渡机器人于WAIC 2026 “一脑多形”：让不同机器人共享同一大脑 面对具身智能商业化中真实世界数据缺乏、工程化与制造能力、商业闭环、全球部署四大核心挑战，普渡提出“一脑多形”技术理念——让不同形态的机器人共享一套统一的底层模型和软
excerpt_i18n.en: On July 17, the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference and High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance opened in Shanghai. The conference is themed "Intelligent Partners, Creating the Future Together." As a global leader in commercial service robots, Pudu Robotics held the "From Serving the World to Shaping the Future with Intelligence – Pudu AI Technology Lighthouse Briefing" on the first day of the conference, systematically elaborating on the "one brain, multi-form" Physical Agent technology concept and unveiling the humanoid intelligent operations partner PUDU D7 for the first time offline. As embodied intelligence moves from laboratories into the deep waters of industrialization, whoever can first complete the "technology-product-commercialization-data" closed loop in real business scenarios will define the rules of the Physical AI era. Pudu Robotics, ranking first globally in both revenue and shipment volume for commercial service robots, is providing its own answer through concrete actions. At the briefing, Wu Xiang, General Manager of Pudu's Embodied Intelligence Product Line, stated: In the Physical AI era, robots are becoming a key vehicle for AI to enter the real world. Over the past few years, the rapid development of large language models, multimodal models, and AI agents has enabled artificial intelligence to transition from "generating content" to "understanding tasks." As capabilities in perception, reasoning, planning, and execution continue to mature, AI is stepping out of the digital realm and into the real physical world. El lema de esta edición es "Compañeros inteligentes, creando el futuro juntos". Como líder mundial en robots de servicio comercial, Pudu Robotics celebró el primer día de la conferencia la "Reunión de Comunicación del Faro Tecnológico de IA de Pudu: del Servicio al Mundo a la Fabricación del Futuro", explicando sistemáticamente el concepto tecnológico de "un cerebro, múltiples formas" como Agente Físico, y mostró por primera vez en persona a su compañero de trabajo inteligente de tipo humanoide PUDU D7.
